symptomShortText: Loose end cap bolts found at final audit

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-4471, Shift B - torque wrench sign-off missing on 63 consecutive units; operator ran the final pass by hand after the wrench was sent for calibration
EQ-ASSY08-002 nutrunner self-test passed each shift start
DOC-7702 Rev F - assembly instruction specifies 36 Nm and a mandatory wrench sign-off; text unchanged
Bolt lot BLT-8890 tensile and thread gauge PASS
Audit torque tester GA-0210, last cal 2026-06-02, R&R 6.0%

fiveWhyChain.question: Why were the end cap bolts loose?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Seating torque measured 18 Nm against a 34-38 Nm window, roughly half the required clamp load

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was the torque only half of specification?
fiveWhyChain.answer: The final torque pass was done by hand instead of with the calibrated nutrunner, so no controlled torque was ever applied

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was the pass done by hand? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: The wrench went out for calibration and no replacement was staged; the operator continued production rather than stopping the line, and nothing in the process blocked it
fiveWhyChain.evidenceCitation: Test equipment register GA-0210 / shift handover note

actions.actionText: Recall and re-torque all 63 units from the affected Shift B window
Stage a calibrated backup nutrunner at WC-ASSY-08 before any tool leaves for calibration
Make the MES step refuse a unit sign-off unless a calibrated torque tool ID is scanned

fmeaLink.description: Insufficient clamp load from uncontrolled torque

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Sign-off gaps in the MES log pinpointed the exact production window within hours
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: The process relied on the operator stopping the line voluntarily; nothing enforced it

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: G45 end caps - WC-ASSY-08 - Shift B units built while the torque wrench was away for calibration
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: G45 built on Shift A and Shift C - WC-ASSY-11 - wrench available throughout
isIsNot.notes: Defect window matches the calibration absence exactly

customerReference.complaintReference: N/A - internal defect, no customer reference
